hazards.name: Thunderstorm wind
hazards.frequency_note: about 12 a year reported in the county (376 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: A cold front moved slowly south across southeast Michigan on the morning and afternoon of the 18th.

hazards.name: Hail
hazards.frequency_note: about 7.3 a year reported in the county (223 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: Numerous strong to severe thunderstorms developed during the late afternoon of June 15th, mainly south of I-96.

hazards.name: High wind
hazards.frequency_note: about once a year reported in the county (44 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: A non thunderstorm event took place over the state on Wednesday, March 8, 2017, as high winds brought wind gusts in excess of 60 mph!

hazards.name: Heavy snow
hazards.frequency_note: about once a year reported in the county (35 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: Low pressure tracked from the western Gulf of Mexico northeast to northern Ohio on the 16th and 17th.

hazards.name: Lightning
hazards.frequency_note: most years reported in the county (21 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: Three men were installing a roof at an apartment complex under construction when they were struck by lightning.

hazards.name: Winter storm
hazards.frequency_note: most years reported in the county (22 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: A large and complex low pressure system impacted the Great Lakes region.

hazards.name: River flooding
hazards.frequency_note: most years reported in the county (21 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: Heavy rain fell over southeast Michigan from September 12th-14th, with widespread 3 to 6 inches reported.

hazards.name: Extreme cold
hazards.frequency_note: about one every 2 years reported in the county (14 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: A bitter cold airmass blasted into the region on Saturday, February the 3rd and persisted through Tuesday, February the 6th.

hazards.name: Flash flood
hazards.frequency_note: most years reported in the county (17 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: Numerous roads became impassable due to flash flooding. Parts of Ann Arbor received around 5.5 inches of rainfall, with Ypsilanti reporting the highest total of 6.76 inches.

hazards.name: Extreme heat
hazards.frequency_note: about one every 2 years reported in the county (15 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: A six day heat impacted Southeast Michigan July 14th through the 19th with high temperatures ranging from the upper 80s to mid 90s.

hazards.name: Tornado
hazards.frequency_note: about one every 4 years reported in the county (7 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: A National Weather Service Storm Survey confirmed an EF-3 tornado touched down near Dexter, MI with maximum wind speeds of 135-140 mph.

hazards.name: Ice storm
hazards.frequency_note: about one every 8 years reported in the county (4 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: A major winter storm impacted Southeast Michigan during the daytime and evening hours of February 22, 2023.

hazards.name: Drought
hazards.frequency_note: about one every 15 years reported in the county (2 in 1996-2026)

worst_local_event.summary: An upper level high pressure ridge dominated the weather pattern across southeast Michigan beginning late June and continuing through the month of July.

notes: NRI ratings and frequencies are county-wide and compare the county with all US counties; they are not specific to the campus. NRI frequency units differ by hazard (events per year, event-days per year for heat, cold, drought and winter weather, annual probability for earthquake and wildfire). NRI Strong Wind, Winter Weather and Inland Flooding each cover two of our hazards, so the second one carries the rating only. Storm Events zone reports can cover a forecast zone larger than the county. Likelihood (chance of at least one event a year) and the order are computed by PARALLEL, not FEMA: from the local Storm Events rate when there is one, otherwise from NRI frequency capped at 0.5; ties go to the higher NRI rating. Storm Events: Washtenaw County reports plus forecast zone MIZ075 (Washtenaw). Storm Events 1996 through June 2026 (NCEI detail files, versions c2026xxxx); worst event = largest property+crop damage, with a death weighted as $10M and an injury as $1M.
